            document.getElementById('openFDNativeBtn').onclick = () => window.open(`https://${REAL_FD_DOMAIN}/a/tickets/${ticketId}`, '_blank');
            
            const suggestedTheme = ticketRef.cType || "General";
            const tagBtn = document.getElementById('tagThemeBtn');
            if (tagBtn) {
                tagBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('suggestedTheme').innerText = suggestedTheme;
            }

            document.getElementById('convoMeta').innerText = `Ticket Context & History: #${ticketId} | ${sub}`;
            body.innerHTML = ''; modal.classList.remove('hidden'); setTimeout(() => panel.classList.remove('translate-x-full'), 10);
            const convos = ticketRef._fullConversations || [];
            if (convos.length === 0) body.innerHTML = `<div class="bg-white p-6 border rounded-xl shadow-sm"><h3 class="font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase text-xs tracking-widest mb-4">Original Request Content</h3><div class="text-sm">${ticketRef.description_text}</div><hr class="my-6"><p class="text-slate-500 italic">No agent or client replies found on record yet.</p></div>`;
            else {
                body.innerHTML = `<div class="bg-white p-6 border rounded-xl shadow-sm border-l-4 border-indigo-400 mb-6"><h3 class="font-bold text-indigo-400 uppercase text-xs tracking-widest mb-4">Original Entry</h3><div class="text-sm">${ticketRef.description_text}</div></div>`;
                convos.forEach(c => {
                    const isClient = c.incoming; const d = document.createElement('div');
                    d.className = `p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm max-w-[85%] mb-4 ${isClient ? 'bg-white border text-slate-800' : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-900 border border-indigo-100 self-end ml-auto'}`;
                    d.innerHTML = `<div class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">${isClient ? 'Customer / External' : 'Agent'} | ${new Date(c.created_at).toLocaleString()}</div><div class="prose prose-sm text-sm break-words whitespace-pre-wrap">${c.body_text || ''}</div>`;
                    body.appendChild(d);
                });
            }
        }

        function closeConvoModal() { document.getElementById('convoPanel').classList.add('translate-x-full'); setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('convoModal').classList.add('hidden'), 300); }
        let kpiMap = { critical: [], high: [], action: [], watch: [], stable: [], sla: [], unresponded: [], quickwins: [], spamreview: [], autoclose: [] };
        function openModal(type, externalTicks = null) {
            const mBody = document.getElementById('modalTableBody'); if(mBody) mBody.innerHTML = ''; // Ensure mBody exists
            const list = externalTicks || kpiMap[type] || [];
            list.forEach(t => {
                const shortSub = t.subject.length > 50 ? t.subject.substring(0, 47) + '...' : t.subject;
                if(mBody) mBody.innerHTML += `<tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-left" onclick="triggerDashboardDetail('${t.id}', '${t.subject.replace(/'/g, "\'")}', globalTickets.find(x=>x.id==${t.id}))"><td class="p-4 border-b text-blue-600 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">#${t.id}</td><td class="p-4 border-b"><span class="text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]" style="background-color:${t.brandObj.hex}">${t.brandObj.name}</span></td><td class="p-4 border-b font-bold ${t.computedScore >= 11 ? 'text-red-600' : ''} text-center">${t.computedScore}</td><td class="p-4 border-b font-medium text-sm whitespace-normal break-words">${shortSub}</td><td class="p-4 border-b text-center font-mono text-xs">${t._daysSinceAgent}d</td><td class="p-4 border-b text-xs text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">${new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td></tr>`;
            });
            if(document.getElementById('mText')) document.getElementById('mText').innerText = (type !== 'custom' ? type.toUpperCase() : 'Segment Details') + ` (${list.length} Tickets)`;
            document.getElementById('ticketModal').classList.remove('hidden');
        }
        async function tagTicketTheme() {
            if (!currentConvoTicket) return;
            const theme = document.getElementById('suggestedTheme').innerText;
            const btn = document.getElementById('tagThemeBtn');
            const original = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Tagging...';
            
            try {
                const tags = [...(currentConvoTicket.tags || [])];
                if (!tags.includes(theme)) tags.push(theme);
                
                const res = await fetch(`/api/v2/tickets/${currentConvoTicket.id}`, {
                    method: 'PUT',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ tags: tags })
                });
                if (res.ok) {
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Tagged!';
                    btn.classList.replace('bg-indigo-700', 'bg-green-600');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        btn.innerHTML = original;
                        btn.classList.replace('bg-green-600', 'bg-indigo-700');
                    }, 2000);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i> Error';
                setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = original; }, 2000);
            }
        }

        function closeModal() { document.getElementById('ticketModal').classList.add('hidden'); }

        function closeAISummaryModal() { document.getElementById('aiSummaryPanel').classList.add('translate-x-full'); setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('aiSummaryModal').classList.add('hidden'), 300); }

        function sentIcon_logic(pct) {
            if (pct >= 50) return 'fa-angry';
            if (pct >= 25) return 'fa-meh';
            return 'fa-smile';
        }

        function processLive(ts) {
            kpiMap = { critical: [], high: [], action: [], watch: [], stable: [], sla: [], unresponded: [], quickwins: [], spamreview: [], autoclose: [] };
            creationGroups = {}; brandGroups = {}; tierGroups = { critical: [], high: [], action: [], watch: [], stable: [] }; themeGroups = {}; multiRespGroups = { "Single Reply/Agent Queue": [], "Customer Multi-Responsive": [] };
            ageCUnList = { '< 3 Days': [], '3-5 Days': [], '> 5 Days': [] }; ageCRsList = { '< 3 Days': [], '3-5 Days': [], '> 5 Days': [] }; // Corrected variable name
            let creationCounts = {}, bDist = Array(6).fill(0), bKeys = Object.keys(BRAND_GROUPS), themesCount = {};
            let ageCUn = { '< 3 Days': 0, '3-5 Days': 0, '> 5 Days': 0 }, ageCRs = { '< 3 Days': 0, '3-5 Days': 0, '> 5 Days': 0 };
            let brandTypeMap = {}; for (const b of bKeys) { brandTypeMap[BRAND_GROUPS[b].name] = {}; }
            let triageBrandMap = { critical: {}, high: {}, action: {}, watch: {}, stable: {} };

            ts.forEach(t => {
                t.assignedAgent = null;
                if (t.tags && Array.isArray(t.tags)) {
                    const foundAgent = AGENT_NAMES.find(a => t.tags.some(tag => tag.toLowerCase() === a.toLowerCase())); // Case-insensitive check
                    if (foundAgent) t.assignedAgent = foundAgent;
                }

                if (t.ageDays >= 5) kpiMap.sla.push(t);
                
                // Logic for Quick Wins and Spam Review
                const fullConvoText = ((t.description_text || '') + ' ' + (t._fullConversations || []).map(c => (c.body_text || '')).join(' ')).toLowerCase();
                const hasDiscountKeywords = fullConvoText.includes('discount code') || fullConvoText.includes('welcome discount');
                const isInfoEnquiry = /\b(info|store|compliment|thank you)\b/i.test(fullConvoText) && fullConvoText.length < 500;

                if (t.isSpamSubject) { // Rule: "EXTERNAL:" is the only word in the subject
                    kpiMap.spamreview.push(t);
                } else if (t.isResolvedSentiment || hasDiscountKeywords || isInfoEnquiry) {
                    // Quick Wins: positive sentiment, discount keywords, or simple info enquiry
                    kpiMap.quickwins.push(t);
                }
                kpiMap.autoclose = [...kpiMap.quickwins, ...kpiMap.spamreview];
                
                t.isMultiResp = t.consecutiveInboundCount >= 2;
                if (t.isMultiResp) { multiRespGroups["Customer Multi-Responsive"].push(t); } else { multiRespGroups["Single Reply/Agent Queue"].push(t); }

                const ymd = t.created_at.split('T')[0];
                creationCounts[ymd] = (creationCounts[ymd] || 0) + 1;
                if (!creationGroups[ymd]) creationGroups[ymd] = []; creationGroups[ymd].push(t);

                let t_tier = 'stable';
                if (t.computedScore >= 11) { t_tier = 'critical'; kpiMap.critical.push(t); }
                else if (t.computedScore >= 9) { t_tier = 'high'; kpiMap.high.push(t); }
                else if (t.computedScore >= 7) { t_tier = 'action'; kpiMap.action.push(t); }
                else if (t.computedScore >= 4) { t_tier = 'watch'; kpiMap.watch.push(t); }
                else { kpiMap.stable.push(t); }

                tierGroups[t_tier].push(t); triageBrandMap[t_tier][t.brandObj.name] = (triageBrandMap[t_tier][t.brandObj.name] || 0) + 1;

                const bI = bKeys.indexOf(t.group_id.toString());
                if (bI >= 0) {
                    bDist[bI]++; if (!brandGroups[bKeys[bI]]) brandGroups[bKeys[bI]] = [];
                    brandGroups[bKeys[bI]].push(t); brandTypeMap[t.brandObj.name][t.cType] = (brandTypeMap[t.brandObj.name][t.cType] || 0) + 1;
                }

                let theme = t.cType; let sLow = t.subject.toLowerCase() + " " + t.gistPhrase.toLowerCase();
                if (sLow.includes('return') || sLow.includes('exchange') || sLow.includes('size')) theme = "Returns & Sizes";
                if (sLow.includes('where') || sLow.includes('track') || sLow.includes('shipping')) theme = "WISMO";
                if (sLow.includes('defect') || sLow.includes('wrong') || sLow.includes('damage')) theme = "Defect/Error";
                if (sLow.includes('cancel') || sLow.includes('refund')) theme = "Cancel/Refund";
                themesCount[theme] = (themesCount[theme] || 0) + 1;
                if (!themeGroups[theme]) themeGroups[theme] = []; themeGroups[theme].push(t);

                const aBracket = (t.ageDays < 3) ? '< 3 Days' : ((t.ageDays <= 5) ? '3-5 Days' : '> 5 Days');
                // No Agent Touch: strictly tickets with ZERO agent replies
                if (!t._hasAgentReply) { ageCUn[aBracket]++; ageCUnList[aBracket].push(t); kpiMap.unresponded.push(t); }
                else if (t.consecutiveInboundCount > 0) { ageCRs[aBracket]++; ageCRsList[aBracket].push(t); }
            });

            document.getElementById('kpiCritical').innerText = kpiMap.critical.length;
            document.getElementById('kpiHigh').innerText = kpiMap.high.length;
            document.getElementById('kpiAction').innerText = kpiMap.action.length;
            document.getElementById('kpiWatch').innerText = kpiMap.watch.length;
            document.getElementById('kpiStable').innerText = kpiMap.stable.length;
            document.getElementById('kpiSLA').innerText = kpiMap.sla.length;
            document.getElementById('kpiUnresponded').innerText = kpiMap.unresponded.length; 
            document.getElementById('kpiAutoClose').innerText = kpiMap.autoclose.length;
            document.getElementById('dynamicNoticeCount').innerText = `${ts.length} active tickets`; // Update dynamic notice count

            // Populate reopened list
            const reopenedBox = document.getElementById('reopenedListContainer');
            if (reopenedBox) {
                const multiReopened = ts.filter(t => t._reopenCount >= 2).sort((a, b) => b._reopenCount - a._reopenCount);
                if (multiReopened.length > 0) {
                    reopenedBox.innerHTML = multiReopened.map(t => `<div class="p-3 mb-2 bg-red-50 border border-red-100 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-100 cursor-pointer" onclick="triggerDashboardDetail('${t.id}', '${t.subject.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', globalTickets.find(x=>x.id==${t.id}))"><div class="flex justify-between items-center"><span class="font-bold text-red-800 text-xs">#${t.id}</span><span class="bg-red-600 text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black">${t._reopenCount} REOPENS</span></div><div class="text-[11px] text-slate-700 mt-1 font-medium truncate">${t.subject}</div></div>`).join('');
                } else {
                    reopenedBox.innerHTML = '<p class="text-slate-400 italic text-center mt-32 text-sm">No multi-reopened tickets found.</p>';
                }
            }

            updateStrategyLists();
            renderAgentAssignments();

            // Update other KPI cards to show ticket lists
            const kpiCardConfig = {
                critical: 'Critical',
                high: 'High',
                action: 'Action',
                watch: 'Watch',
                stable: 'Stable',
                sla: 'SLA',
                unresponded: 'Unresponded',
                autoclose: 'AutoClose'
            };
            Object.keys(kpiCardConfig).forEach(id => {
                const listContainer = document.getElementById(`kpi${kpiCardConfig[id]}List`);
                if (!listContainer) return;

                listContainer.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous content

                const tickets = kpiMap[id] || [];
                let ticketListHtml = '';
                if (tickets.length > 0) {
                    ticketListHtml += tickets.slice(0, 10).map(t => `<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-600 truncate border-b border-slate-50 py-1" title="${t.subject}"><a href="https://${REAL_FD_DOMAIN}/a/tickets/${t.id}" target="_blank" class="text-blue-600 font-bold">#${t.id}</a> ${t.subject}</div>`).join('');
                    if (tickets.length > 10) ticketListHtml += `<p class="text-[9px] text-slate-400 text-center mt-1">...and ${tickets.length - 10} more</p>`;
                } else {
                    ticketListHtml += '<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">No tickets in this category.</p>';
                }
                listContainer.innerHTML = ticketListHtml;
            });

            // Brand Sentiment Score Cards
            const sentBox = document.getElementById('sentimentCards'); 
            if (sentBox) {
                sentBox.innerHTML = ''; bKeys.forEach(k => {
                    const brand = BRAND_GROUPS[k];
                    const bTickets = brandGroups[k] || [];
                    const total = bTickets.length;
                    const negCount = bTickets.filter(t => t.mildSentimentHit || t.strongSentimentHit || t.severeEscalationHit).length;
                    const sentPct = total > 0 ? Math.round((negCount / total) * 100) : 0;
                    const avgScore = total > 0 ? (bTickets.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.computedScore, 0) / total).toFixed(1) : 0;

                    // Sentiment Trend Logic (Compare with globalClosedTickets/yesterday if possible)
                    let trendIcon = '';
                    if (globalClosedTickets.length > 0) {
                        const yesterdayBrandTickets = globalClosedTickets.filter(t => t.group_id.toString() === k);
                        const yTotal = yesterdayBrandTickets.length;
                        const yNeg = yesterdayBrandTickets.filter(t => t.mildSentimentHit || t.strongSentimentHit || t.severeEscalationHit).length;
                        const yPct = yTotal > 0 ? Math.round((yNeg / yTotal) * 100) : null;
                        if (yPct !== null) {
                            const diff = sentPct - yPct;
                            if (diff > 5) trendIcon = `<span class="text-red-500 text-[10px] font-bold" title="Sentiment Worsening"><i class="fas fa-arrow-up text-xs mr-0.5"></i>+${diff}%</span>`;
                            else if (diff < -5) trendIcon = `<span class="text-green-500 text-[10px] font-bold" title="Sentiment Improving"><i class="fas fa-arrow-down text-xs mr-0.5"></i>${Math.abs(diff)}%</span>`;
                            else trendIcon = `<span class="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold" title="No significant change">-</span>`;
                        }
                    }

                    const sentIconStr = sentPct >= 50 ? 'fa-angry' : sentPct >= 25 ? 'fa-frown' : 'fa-smile';
                    let sentColor = 'text-green-600 bg-green-50 border-green-200';
                    if (sentPct >= 50 || avgScore >= 9) sentColor = 'text-red-600 bg-red-50 border-red-200';
                    else if (sentPct >= 25 || avgScore >= 7) sentColor = 'text-orange-600 bg-orange-50 border-orange-200';

                    const sentLabel = sentPct >= 50 ? 'High Risk' : sentPct >= 25 ? 'Moderate' : 'Positive';
                    
                    sentBox.innerHTML += `<div class="rounded-xl p-3 border ${sentColor} flex flex-col gap-1 relative overflow-hidden">
                    <div class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase flex justify-between items-center mb-1" style="color:${brand.hex}"><span>${brand.name}</span> ${trendIcon}</div>
                    <div class="text-[9px] text-slate-500 mb-2 leading-snug">${negCount} of ${total} tickets flagged with negative risk.</div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span class="text-lg font-black">${sentPct}%</span>
                        <i class="fas ${sentIconStr} text-xl opacity-70"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase">${sentLabel} · Avg Score: ${avgScore}</div>
                </div>`;
                });
            }

            // Brand Activity KPI Cards
            const cardBox = document.getElementById('brandActivityCards'); cardBox.innerHTML = '';
            bKeys.forEach(k => {
                const brand = BRAND_GROUPS[k];
                const total = brandGroups[k]?.length || 0;
                const last24 = (brandGroups[k] || []).filter(t => t.ageDays <= 1).length;
                const ratio = total > 0 ? Math.round((last24 / total) * 100) : 0;
                cardBox.innerHTML += `
                    <div class="bg-slate-50 rounded-xl p-3 border border-slate-100">
                        <div class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase mb-1">${brand.name}</div>
                        <div class="flex items-end justify-between">
                            <div class="text-xl font-black text-slate-800">${last24}</div>
                            <div class="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center gap-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-percent text-[8px]"></i> ${ratio}%
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-[8px] text-slate-500 mt-1">Created < 24h</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            // Multi-ticket notice
            const multiTicketBox = document.getElementById('multiTicketNotice');
            const requesterGroups = {};
            globalTickets.forEach(t => {
                if (t.requester_id) {
                    if (!requesterGroups[t.requester_id]) requesterGroups[t.requester_id] = [];
                    requesterGroups[t.requester_id].push(t);
                }
            });
            let multiHtml = '';
            Object.values(requesterGroups).forEach(group => {
                if (group.length > 1) {
                    const t = group[0];
                    multiHtml += `<div class="p-2 border-b text-xs"><strong class="text-slate-800">${t.cName}</strong> (${t.cName}) has <strong class="text-purple-600">${group.length} open tickets</strong>. IDs: ${group.map(ticket => `<a href="https://${REAL_FD_DOMAIN}/a/tickets/${ticket.id}" target="_blank" class="text-blue-600 font-bold">#${ticket.id}</a>`).join(', ')}</div>`;
                }
            });
            multiTicketBox.innerHTML = multiHtml || '<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">No customers with multiple tickets found.</p>';

            renderCharts(creationCounts, tierGroups, bDist, bKeys, themesCount, ageCUn, ageCRs, triageBrandMap, brandTypeMap);
        }

        function renderCharts(cCounts, tGroups, bDist, bKeys, themesCount, ageCUn, ageCRs, trgBM, bTM) {
            Chart.defaults.font.family = "'Inter', sans-serif";
            const fontWhite = { color: 'white', font: { weight: 'bold', size: 12 } };
            const bLabels = bKeys.map(k => BRAND_GROUPS[k].name);
            const dateLabels = Object.keys(cCounts).sort();

            if (creationChartInst) creationChartInst.destroy();
            creationChartInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('creationChart'), {
                type: 'line',
                data: { labels: dateLabels, datasets: [{ data: dateLabels.map(k => cCounts[k]), borderColor: '#3b82f6', backgroundColor: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2)', borderWidth: 3, tension: 0.3, pointBackgroundColor: '#fff', pointBorderColor: '#3b82f6', pointRadius: 6, pointHoverRadius: 8, fill: true, hitRadius: 15 }] },
                options: {
                    layout: { padding: { right: 20, top: 10, left: 10, bottom: 10 } },
                    responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        datalabels: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            callbacks: {
                                title: items => items[0].label,
                                label: item => ` ${item.raw} ticket${item.raw !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    animation: { duration: 0 },
                    hover: { animationDuration: 0 },
                    interaction: { mode: 'nearest', axis: 'x', intersect: false },
                    onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', creationGroups[dateLabels[els[0].index]]); }
                }
            });

            // Brand specific creation charts (with points + tooltips)
            bKeys.forEach(k => {
                const bName = BRAND_GROUPS[k].name;
                const canvasId = `chart_${bName.toLowerCase().replace("'", "")}`;
                const ctx = document.getElementById(canvasId);
                if (!ctx) return;
                const bTicks = brandGroups[k] || [];
                const bCounts = {}; bTicks.forEach(t => { const ymd = t.created_at.split('T')[0]; bCounts[ymd] = (bCounts[ymd] || 0) + 1; });
                const bDates = Object.keys(bCounts).sort();
                new Chart(ctx, {
                    type: 'line',
                    data: { labels: bDates, datasets: [{ data: bDates.map(d => bCounts[d]), borderColor: BRAND_GROUPS[k].hex, backgroundColor: BRAND_GROUPS[k].hex + '20', borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 3, pointHoverRadius: 6, pointBackgroundColor: BRAND_GROUPS[k].hex, fill: true, tension: 0.3 }] },
                    options: {
                        layout: { padding: { right: 20, top: 10, left: 10, bottom: 10 } },
                        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
                        plugins: {
                            legend: { display: false },
                            datalabels: { display: false },
                            tooltip: {
                                callbacks: {
                                    title: items => items[0].label,
                                    label: item => ` ${item.raw} ticket${item.raw !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`
                                }
                            }
                        },
                        scales: {
                            x: { display: true, ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 4, font: { size: 8 }, maxRotation: 0 } },
                            y: { display: true, ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 4, font: { size: 8 } }, beginAtZero: true }
                        },
                        animation: { duration: 0 },
                        hover: { animationDuration: 0 },
                        interaction: { mode: 'nearest', axis: 'x', intersect: false },
                        onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', brandGroups[k].filter(t => t.created_at.split('T')[0] === bDates[els[0].index])); }
                    }
                });
            });

            if (tierChartInst) tierChartInst.destroy();
            tierChartInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('tierChart'), { type: 'doughnut', data: { labels: ['Critical (11+)', 'High Risk (9-10)', 'Action (7-8)', 'Watch (4-6)', 'Stable (1-3)'], datasets: [{ data: [tGroups.critical.length, tGroups.high.length, tGroups.action.length, tGroups.watch.length, tGroups.stable.length], backgroundColor: ['#7f1d1d', '#b91c1c', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#3b82f6'], borderWidth: 3, borderColor: '#fff' }] }, options: { cutout: '65%', layout: { padding: 10 }, responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'right' }, datalabels: { color: '#fff', font: { weight: 'bold' } }, tooltip: { callbacks: { afterLabel: (context) => { const mapper = ['critical', 'high', 'action', 'watch', 'stable']; const map = trgBM[mapper[context.dataIndex]]; let tStr = "\nBrand Breakdown:"; for (const [bName, count] of Object.entries(map)) { tStr += `\n${bName}: ${count}`; } return tStr; } } } }, onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', [tGroups.critical, tGroups.high, tGroups.action, tGroups.watch, tGroups.stable][els[0].index]); } } });

            if (brandChartInst) brandChartInst.destroy();
            brandChartInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('brandChart'), { type: 'bar', data: { labels: bLabels, datasets: [{ label: 'Tickets', data: bDist, backgroundColor: bKeys.map(k => BRAND_GROUPS[k].hex), borderRadius: 4 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, datalabels: fontWhite, tooltip: { callbacks: { afterLabel: (ctx) => { const bName = bLabels[ctx.dataIndex]; const breakdown = bTM[bName]; let r = '\nTicket Types:'; for (const [tType, count] of Object.entries(breakdown)) { r += `\n${tType}: ${count}`; } return r; } } } }, onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', brandGroups[bKeys[els[0].index]]); } } });

            if (agingChartUnrespondedInst) agingChartUnrespondedInst.destroy();
            agingChartUnrespondedInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('agingChartUnresponded'), { type: 'bar', data: { labels: ['< 3 Days', '3-5 Days', '> 5 Days'], datasets: [{ data: [ageCUn['< 3 Days'], ageCUn['3-5 Days'], ageCUn['> 5 Days']], backgroundColor: ['#f87171', '#dc2626', '#991b1b'], borderRadius: 4 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, datalabels: fontWhite, tooltip: { callbacks: { afterLabel: (ctx) => { const tickets = ageCUnList[['< 3 Days', '3-5 Days', '> 5 Days'][ctx.dataIndex]]; const brandCounts = tickets.reduce((acc, t) => { acc[t.brandObj.name] = (acc[t.brandObj.name] || 0) + 1; return acc; }, {}); return Object.entries(brandCounts).map(([b, c]) => `\n${b}: ${c}`).join(''); } } } }, onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', ageCUnList[['< 3 Days', '3-5 Days', '> 5 Days'][els[0].index]]); } } });

            if (agingChartRespondedInst) agingChartRespondedInst.destroy();
            agingChartRespondedInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('agingChartResponded'), { type: 'bar', data: { labels: ['< 3 Days', '3-5 Days', '> 5 Days'], datasets: [{ data: [ageCRs['< 3 Days'], ageCRs['3-5 Days'], ageCRs['> 5 Days']], backgroundColor: ['#34d399', '#059669', '#064e3b'], borderRadius: 4 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, datalabels: fontWhite, tooltip: { callbacks: { afterLabel: (ctx) => { const tickets = ageCRsList[['< 3 Days', '3-5 Days', '> 5 Days'][ctx.dataIndex]]; const brandCounts = tickets.reduce((acc, t) => { acc[t.brandObj.name] = (acc[t.brandObj.name] || 0) + 1; return acc; }, {}); return Object.entries(brandCounts).map(([b, c]) => `\n${b}: ${c}`).join(''); } } } }, onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', ageCRsList[['< 3 Days', '3-5 Days', '> 5 Days'][els[0].index]]); } } });

            if (multiResponseChartInst) multiResponseChartInst.destroy();
            multiResponseChartInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('multiResponseChart'), { type: 'doughnut', data: { labels: ["Single Reply/Agent Queue", "Customer Multi-Responsive"], datasets: [{ data: [multiRespGroups["Single Reply/Agent Queue"].length, multiRespGroups["Customer Multi-Responsive"].length], backgroundColor: ['#94a3b8', '#f59e0b'], borderWidth: 3 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'right' }, datalabels: { color: '#fff', font: { weight: 'bold' } }, tooltip: { callbacks: { afterLabel: (ctx) => { const tickets = ctx.dataIndex === 0 ? multiRespGroups["Single Reply/Agent Queue"] : multiRespGroups["Customer Multi-Responsive"]; const brandCounts = tickets.reduce((acc, t) => { acc[t.brandObj.name] = (acc[t.brandObj.name] || 0) + 1; return acc; }, {}); return Object.entries(brandCounts).map(([b, c]) => `\n${b}: ${c}`).join(''); } } } }, onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', els[0].index === 0 ? multiRespGroups["Single Reply/Agent Queue"] : multiRespGroups["Customer Multi-Responsive"]); } } });

            if (themeChartInst) themeChartInst.destroy();
            const thSort = Object.keys(themesCount).sort((a, b) => themesCount[b] - themesCount[a]);
            themeChartInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('themeChart'), { type: 'bar', data: { labels: thSort, datasets: [{ data: thSort.map(k => themesCount[k]), backgroundColor: ['#8b5cf6', '#ec4899', '#06b6d4', '#f43f5e', '#facc15', '#a855f7'], borderRadius: 4 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, indexAxis: 'y', plugins: { legend: { display: false }, datalabels: { color: '#fff', font: { weight: 'bold', size: 10 } }, tooltip: { callbacks: { afterLabel: (ctx) => { const tickets = themeGroups[thSort[ctx.dataIndex]]; const brandCounts = tickets.reduce((acc, t) => { acc[t.brandObj.name] = (acc[t.brandObj.name] || 0) + 1; return acc; }, {}); return Object.entries(brandCounts).map(([b, c]) => `\n${b}: ${c}`).join(''); } } } }, onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', themeGroups[thSort[els[0].index]]); } } });
        }

        function renderWorkloadCharts() {
            const bKeys = Object.keys(BRAND_GROUPS);
            const ts = globalClosedTickets;

            const getGmt2Date = () => {
                const now = new Date();
                const gmt2 = new Date(now.getTime() + (now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000) + (2 * 3600000));
                return gmt2.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            };
            const todayStr = getGmt2Date();
            const yesterdayDate = new Date(new Date().getTime() + (new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 60000) + (2 * 3600000));
            yesterdayDate.setDate(yesterdayDate.getDate() - 1);
            const yesterdayStr = yesterdayDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];

            const todayCounts = {};
            const yesterdayCounts = {};

            ts.forEach(t => {
                const bName = t.brandObj.name;
                if (t.updated_at.startsWith(todayStr)) {
                    todayCounts[bName] = (todayCounts[bName] || 0) + 1;
                } else if (t.updated_at.startsWith(yesterdayStr)) {
                    yesterdayCounts[bName] = (yesterdayCounts[bName] || 0) + 1;
                }
            });

            const oLabels = bKeys.map(k => BRAND_GROUPS[k].name);
            const todayData = bKeys.map(k => todayCounts[BRAND_GROUPS[k].name] || 0);
            const yesterdayData = bKeys.map(k => yesterdayCounts[BRAND_GROUPS[k].name] || 0);

            if (workloadOverallChartInst) workloadOverallChartInst.destroy();
            workloadOverallChartInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('workloadOverallChart'), {
                type: 'bar',
                data: { labels: oLabels, datasets: [{ data: todayData, backgroundColor: bKeys.map(k => BRAND_GROUPS[k].hex), borderRadius: 4 }] },
                options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, datalabels: { color: '#fff', font: { weight: 'bold' } } }, onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', ts.filter(t => t.brandObj.name === oLabels[els[0].index] && t.updated_at.startsWith(todayStr))); } }
            });

            if (workloadYesterdayChartInst) workloadYesterdayChartInst.destroy();
            workloadYesterdayChartInst = new Chart(document.getElementById('workloadYesterdayChart'), {
                type: 'bar',
                data: { labels: oLabels, datasets: [{ data: yesterdayData, backgroundColor: bKeys.map(k => BRAND_GROUPS[k].hex), borderRadius: 4 }] },
                options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, datalabels: { color: '#fff', font: { weight: 'bold' } } }, onClick: (e, els) => { if (els.length) openModal('custom', ts.filter(t => t.brandObj.name === oLabels[els[0].index] && t.updated_at.startsWith(yesterdayStr))); } }
            });
        }

        function updateStrategyLists() {
            // Update counts for the new separate cards
            if (document.getElementById('stratQuickWinsCount')) document.getElementById('stratQuickWinsCount').innerText = kpiMap.quickwins.length;
            if (document.getElementById('stratSpamReviewCount')) document.getElementById('stratSpamReviewCount').innerText = kpiMap.spamreview.length;
            const stratWinsCountEl = document.getElementById('stratWinsCount');
            if (stratWinsCountEl) stratWinsCountEl.innerText = kpiMap.quickwins.length + kpiMap.spamreview.length;

            const populateStratBox = (boxId, tickets) => {
                // Ensure the boxId is correct for the new structure
                if (boxId === 'stratQuickWinsBox' && document.getElementById('execution').querySelector('#stratQuickWinsBox')) boxId = 'stratQuickWinsBox';
                if (boxId === 'stratSpamReviewBox' && document.getElementById('execution').querySelector('#stratSpamReviewBox')) boxId = 'stratSpamReviewBox';
                const box = document.getElementById(boxId);
                if (box) {
                    box.innerHTML = tickets.map(t => `<div class="p-1 mb-1 border-b text-xs text-slate-600 truncate" title="${t.subject}"><a href="https://${REAL_FD_DOMAIN}/a/tickets/${t.id}" target="_blank" class="text-blue-600 font-bold">#${t.id}</a> ${t.subject}</div>`).join('') || '<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">No tickets.</p>';
                }
            };

            populateStratBox('stratQuickWinsBox', kpiMap.quickwins);
            populateStratBox('stratSpamReviewBox', kpiMap.spamreview);
            // Update counts for the triage buckets
            document.getElementById('kpiStratCritHigh').innerText = kpiMap.critical.length + kpiMap.high.length;
            document.getElementById('kpiStratAction').innerText = kpiMap.action.length;
            document.getElementById('kpiStratWatch').innerText = kpiMap.watch.length; // Ensure this count is updated
            document.getElementById('kpiStratStable').innerText = kpiMap.stable.length;
            populateStratBox('stratCritHighBox', [...kpiMap.critical, ...kpiMap.high]);
            populateStratBox('stratActionBox', kpiMap.action);
            populateStratBox('stratWatchBox', kpiMap.watch);
            populateStratBox('stratStableBox', kpiMap.stable);
        }

        window.renderAgentAssignments = function () {
            const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.agent-buckets-container');
            containers.forEach(c => c.innerHTML = '');

            const assignedTickets = globalTickets.filter(t => t.assignedAgent);

            if (assignedTickets.length === 0) {
                containers.forEach(c => c.innerHTML = '<div class="col-span-full text-slate-400 italic text-sm">No tickets currently assigned to agents.</div>');
                return;
            }

            const agentGroups = {};
            AGENT_NAMES.forEach(a => agentGroups[a] = []);
            assignedTickets.forEach(t => { if (agentGroups[t.assignedAgent]) agentGroups[t.assignedAgent].push(t); });
            
            containers.forEach(container => {
                AGENT_NAMES.forEach(agent => {
                const tickets = agentGroups[agent];
                if (tickets.length === 0) return;

                let html = `<div class="bg-indigo-50/50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 flex flex-col h-[270px] shadow-sm">
                    <h3 class="font-bold text-indigo-900 text-sm uppercase mb-3 flex justify-between items-center">
                        ${agent} <span class="bg-indigo-200 text-indigo-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-bold">${tickets.length}</span>
                    </h3>
                    <div class="bg-white rounded border border-indigo-100 p-2 flex-grow overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">`;

                tickets.forEach(t => {
                    const assignTag = t.tags.find(tag => tag.startsWith('asgn:'));
                    let assignDateStr = "";
                    let ageClass = "";
                    if (assignTag) {
                        const date = new Date(assignTag.split(':')[1]);
                        const diff = Math.floor((new Date() - date) / 86400000);
                        assignDateStr = `Asgn: ${date.toLocaleDateString()}`;
                        if (diff >= 5) ageClass = "bg-red-200 border-red-300";
                        else if (diff >= 4) ageClass = "bg-red-100 border-red-200";
                        else if (diff >= 3) ageClass = "bg-orange-200 border-orange-300";
                        else if (diff >= 2) ageClass = "bg-orange-100 border-orange-200";
                    }

                    html += `<div onclick="triggerDashboardDetail('${t.id}', '${t.subject.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', globalTickets.find(x=>x.id==${t.id}))" class="p-2 mb-2 border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer ${ageClass}">
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
                            <span class="text-blue-600 font-bold text-[10px]">#${t.id} <span style="color:${t.brandObj.hex}" class="ml-1 uppercase">${t.brandObj.name}</span></span>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-500">${assignDateStr}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold ${t.computedScore >= 10 ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-slate-600'}" title="Triage Score">${t.computedScore}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-700 truncate pr-2">${t.subject}</div>
                    </div>`;
                });

                html += `</div></div>`;
                container.innerHTML += html;
            });
            });
        };

        async function refreshAssignments(btn) { 
            if (!globalTickets || globalTickets.length === 0) {
                alert("No ticket data loaded to refresh.");
                return;
            }

            const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Refreshing...';
            btn.disabled = true;

            const ticketIds = globalTickets.map(t => t.id);
            const promises = ticketIds.map(id => fetch(`/api/v2/tickets/${id}`).then(res => res.json()));

            try {
                const updatedTicketsData = await Promise.all(promises);

                updatedTicketsData.forEach(updatedData => {
                    const ticket = globalTickets.find(t => t.id === updatedData.id);
                    if (ticket) {
                        ticket.tags = updatedData.tags; // Update the tags
                        const foundAgent = AGENT_NAMES.find(a => ticket.tags.some(tag => tag.toLowerCase() === a.toLowerCase()));
                        ticket.assignedAgent = foundAgent || null; // Re-evaluate assignment
                    }
                });

                updateStrategyLists();
                window.renderAgentAssignments();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Failed to refresh assignments:", error);
                alert("An error occurred while refreshing assignments. Please check the console.");
            } finally {
                btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
                btn.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function ai_call(prompt) {
            const url = "/api/ai_proxy";
            try {
                const response = await fetch(url, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: prompt })
                });
                if (!response.ok) {
                    const errorBody = await response.text();
                    throw new Error(`AI Proxy failed with status ${response.status}: ${errorBody}`);
                }
                const data = await response.json();
                return data;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("AI Call Error:", error);
                // alert("An error occurred with the AI call. Check the console for details.");
                return {};
            }
        }

        async function generateAndDisplayAISummary(event) {
            const btn = event.currentTarget;
            const oldHtml = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Generating Report...';
            btn.disabled = true;

            try {
                // 1. Generate Chart Images
                const chartIds = ['brandChart', 'tierChart', 'creationChart', 'themeChart'];
                const chartImages = {};
                for (const id of chartIds) { // Iterate over chartIds
                    const canvas = document.getElementById(id);
                    if (canvas) {
                        chartImages[id] = await html2canvas(canvas.parentElement, { backgroundColor: '#ffffff', scale: 1.5 }).then(c => c.toDataURL('image/png'));
                    }
                }

                // 2. AI Summaries
                const overallPrompt = `Analyze the following summary of current open customer support tickets. Write exactly a 5-line paragraph summarizing the ticket contents, the overall themes, and any critical issues. Return JSON with a single key 'summary' containing the paragraph.\n\n${globalTickets.slice(0, 50).map(t => `- ${t.brandObj.name}: ${t.subject}`).join('\n')}`;
                const overallSummaryRes = await ai_call(overallPrompt);
                const overallSummary = overallSummaryRes.summary || "Overall summary is currently unavailable.";

                let brandSynopsisHtml = "";
                for (const brandName of Object.keys(BRAND_GROUPS).map(k => BRAND_GROUPS[k].name).sort()) { // Ensure bKeys is used correctly
                    const brandTickets = globalTickets.filter(t => t.brandObj.name === brandName);
                    if (brandTickets.length > 0) {
                        const context = brandTickets.slice(0, 15).map(t => `ID ${t.id}: ${t.subject}`).join('\n');
                        const prompt = `For ${brandName}, analyze these tickets:\n${context}\nReturn JSON with 'pulse' (3-4 sentence trend summary highlighting critical/high-risk issues) and 'actions' (3-4 bullet point list of specific tickets to address).`;
                        const synopsisRes = await ai_call(prompt);
                        const synopsis = synopsisRes.pulse || 'Synopsis currently unavailable.';
                        const actions = synopsisRes.actions || [];
                        brandSynopsisHtml += `<h3 class="font-bold text-lg text-slate-700 mt-4">${brandName} Synopsis</h3><p class="text-sm text-slate-600">${synopsis}</p>`;
                        if (actions.length > 0) brandSynopsisHtml += `<ul class="list-disc list-inside text-sm mt-2 space-y-1">${actions.map(a => `<li>${a}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`;
                    }
                }

                // 3. Motivational Quote
                const quoteRes = await ai_call("Return JSON with one key 'quote' containing an inspirational quote for a customer service team.");
                const quote = quoteRes.quote || 'Excellence is a habit.';

                // 4. Assemble HTML for the modal
                const reportHtml = `
                    <div class="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-md border border-slate-200">
                        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-indigo-700 mb-3">Executive Summary</h2>
                        <p class="text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">${overallSummary}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                        <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-md border border-slate-200 text-center">
                            <h3 class="font-semibold text-slate-600 text-sm mb-2">Brand Volume</h3>
                            ${chartImages.brandChart ? `<img src="${chartImages.brandChart}" alt="Brand Volume Chart" class="w-full h-auto rounded">` : '<p>Chart not available.</p>'}
                        </div>
                        <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-md border border-slate-200 text-center">
                            <h3 class="font-semibold text-slate-600 text-sm mb-2">Triage Priority</h3>
                            ${chartImages.tierChart ? `<img src="${chartImages.tierChart}" alt="Triage Priority Chart" class="w-full h-auto rounded">` : '<p>Chart not available.</p>'}
                        </div>
                         <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-md border border-slate-200 text-center">
                            <h3 class="font-semibold text-slate-600 text-sm mb-2">Ticket Creation</h3>
                            ${chartImages.creationChart ? `<img src="${chartImages.creationChart}" alt="Creation Chart" class="w-full h-auto rounded">` : '<p>Chart not available.</p>'}
                        </div>
                         <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-md border border-slate-200 text-center">
                            <h3 class="font-semibold text-slate-600 text-sm mb-2">Detected Themes</h3>
                            ${chartImages.themeChart ? `<img src="${chartImages.themeChart}" alt="Theme Chart" class="w-full h-auto rounded">` : '<p>Chart not available.</p>'}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-md border border-slate-200">
                        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-indigo-700 mb-4">Brand-by-Brand Synopsis</h2>
                        <div class="space-y-4">${brandSynopsisHtml}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-center italic text-slate-500 p-4">"${quote}"</div>
                `;

                // 5. Display in Modal
                document.getElementById('aiSummaryBody').innerHTML = reportHtml;
                document.getElementById('aiSummaryModal').classList.remove('hidden');
                setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('aiSummaryPanel').classList.remove('translate-x-full'), 10);

                btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Summary Processed';
                btn.onclick = () => { // Re-bind button to open modal
                    document.getElementById('aiSummaryModal').classList.remove('hidden');
                    setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('aiSummaryPanel').classList.remove('translate-x-full'), 10);
                };

            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Error generating AI summary:", error);
                alert("Failed to generate AI summary. See console for details.");
                btn.innerHTML = oldHtml;
            } finally {
                btn.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function sendAISummaryEmail() {
            const emailBodyContent = document.getElementById('aiSummaryBody').innerHTML;
            const subject = `AI-Generated CS Morning Brief – ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })}`;
            
            const btnContainer = document.getElementById('aiSummaryActions');
            btnContainer.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-white text-lg"></i><span class="text-white text-sm">Sending...</span>';

            Email.send({
                Host: "smtp.gmail.com",
                Username: "taswell@ecomplete.co.za",
                Password: "evpd vqfd vwku krkn",
                To: "taswell@ecomplete.co.za",
                From: "taswell@ecomplete.co.za",
                Subject: subject,
                Body: emailBodyContent
            }).then(message => {
                if (message === 'OK') {
                    btnContainer.innerHTML = '<span class="text-green-300 font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Sent Successfully!</span>';
                } else {
                    alert("SMTP Delivery Warning: " + message);
                    btnContainer.innerHTML = '<button onclick="sendAISummaryEmail()" class="bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 border border-red-400 rounded px-4 py-2 font-bold text-sm shadow-sm transition"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-2"></i> Retry Send</button>';
                }
            }).catch(e => {
                alert("Exception during email send: " + e);
                btnContainer.innerHTML = '<button onclick="sendAISummaryEmail()" class="bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 border border-red-400 rounded px-4 py-2 font-bold text-sm shadow-sm transition"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-2"></i> Retry Send</button>';
            });
        }
    </script>

                    let TICKET_DATA = {};

                    async function startGeneration() {
                        const btn = document.getElementById('generateBtn');
                        const status = document.getElementById('statusLog');
                        const landing = document.getElementById('landingPage');
                        const main = document.getElementById('mainContent');

                        btn.disabled = true;
                        btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳ Generating Analysis...</span>';
                        
                        try {
                            status.innerText = "Connecting to Strategic API...";
                            // We use the /api/analyze background task pattern from api_server.py
                            const startResp = await fetch('/api/analyze', { method: 'POST' });
                            if (!startResp.ok) throw new Error("API Connection Failed");

                            // Poll for results
                            let completed = false;
                            while (!completed) {
                                const statusResp = await fetch('/api/status');
                                const state = await statusResp.json();
                                
                                status.innerText = state.message || "Analyzing data...";
                                
                                if (state.status === 'completed') {
                                    renderBrief(state.results);
                                    completed = true;
                                } else if (state.status === 'error') {
                                    throw new Error(state.error || "Analysis failed");
                                }
                                
                                if (!completed) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
                            }

                            landing.style.opacity = '0';
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                landing.style.display = 'none';
                                main.style.display = 'block';
                            }, 500);

                        } catch (err) {
                            console.error(err);
                            status.innerText = "Error: " + err.message;
                            btn.disabled = false;
                            btn.innerHTML = '<span>⚡ Try Again</span>';
                        }
                    }

                    function renderBrief(data) {

                        document.querySelector('.kpi-box.critical .val').innerText = critical.length;
                        document.querySelector('.kpi-box:nth-child(3) .val').innerText = data.no_first_count || 0;
                        document.querySelector('.kpi-box:nth-child(4) .val').innerText = data.delayed_count || 0;

                        // We can't filter all no_first/delayed in JS if we only have top 100, 
                        // so we'll rely on the counts from the API for the boxes, 
                        // but the modals will show whatever we have in the 'tickets' list for now.
                        TICKET_DATA = {
                            "critical": JSON.stringify(critical.map(t => ({id: t.id, brand: t.brand, subject: t.subject, score: t.risk_score}))),

                            "delayed": JSON.stringify(data.tickets.filter(t => {
                                const lastTouch = t.stats?.agent_responded_at || t.created_at;
                                return (new Date() - new Date(lastTouch)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) >= 3;
                            }).map(t => ({id: t.id, brand: t.brand, subject: t.subject, score: t.risk_score})))
                        };

--- Freshdesk/freshdesk/cs_team_morning_strategic_brief/cs_morning_brief3.py ---

import os
import json
import time
import random
import logging
import base64
import smtplib
import sys
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Import the official SDK
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

# Load environment variables (Override existing to ensure root .env is used)
load_dotenv(override=True)

# ======================
# CONFIGURATION
# ======================

# SECURITY: Fetched from .env (no hardcoded defaults)
GEMINI_API_KEY = os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY")
FD_API_KEY = os.getenv("FRESHDESK_API_KEY")
SENDER_PASS = os.getenv("EMAIL_PASS")
SENDER_EMAIL = os.getenv("SENDER_EMAIL", "taswell@ecomplete.co.za")
RECIPIENT = os.getenv("RECIPIENT_EMAIL", "taswell@ecomplete.co.za")
DOMAIN = os.getenv("FRESHDESK_DOMAIN", "ecomplete").replace(".freshdesk.com", "")

# MODEL: Using gemini-1.5-flash (Stable, High performance, Free tier compatible)
MODEL_ID = "gemini-1.5-flash" 

# BRAND PRIORITY: Higher weight for key clients
BRAND_WEIGHTS = {
    "LEVI’S SOUTH AFRICA": 1.5,
    "Bounty": 1.4,
    "REEBOK ONLINE": 1.4,
    "SUPERDRY ONLINE": 1.2,
    "DIESEL ONLINE": 1.2,
    "PICK n PAY CLOTHING": 1.2
}

GROUP_MAP = {
    24000008969: ("LEVI’S SOUTH AFRICA", "#C41230"),
    24000009010: ("DIESEL ONLINE", "#000000"),
    24000009052: ("HURLEY ONLINE", "#00AEEF"),
    24000009038: ("JEEP APPAREL", "#4B5320"),
    24000009035: ("REEBOK ONLINE", "#003366"),
    24000009051: ("SUPERDRY ONLINE", "#FF6600"),
    24000005392: ("PICK n PAY CLOTHING", "#005A9C")
}

STATUS_MAP = {
    2: "Open",
    3: "Pending",
    4: "Resolved",
    5: "Closed",
    6: "Waiting on Customer",
    7: "Waiting on Third Party"
}

KEYWORDS = {
    "refund": ["refund", "credited", "money back", "repayment", "reimbursement"],
    "delivery": ["delivery", "tracking", "waybill", "courier", "dispatch", "parcel", "shipping", "haven't received"],
    "returns": ["return", "exchange", "rma", "collection", "pick up", "wrong item", "damaged"],
    "escalation": ["ceo", "cgso", "legal", "complaint", "hellopeter", "ombudsman", "unacceptable", "lawyer", "consumer protection"],
    "urgency": ["urgent", "asap", "immediately", "quick", "hurry", "priority"]
}

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class MorningBriefAutomation:
    def __init__(self):
        if not GEMINI_API_KEY or not FD_API_KEY:
            logger.error("FATAL: Missing API Keys in .env file.")
            sys.exit(1)

        # Debug: Log masked key to verify it's the right one
        masked_key = f"{GEMINI_API_KEY[:6]}...{GEMINI_API_KEY[-4:]}" if GEMINI_API_KEY else "None"
        logger.info(f"Using Gemini Key: {masked_key}")

        self.client = genai.Client(api_key=GEMINI_API_KEY)
        
        # Debug: List models to see what's available
        try:
            available_models = [m.name for m in self.client.models.list()]
            logger.info(f"Available models: {available_models[:5]}...")
            
            # Dynamically select the best available Flash model
            global MODEL_ID
            flash_models = [m.replace("models/", "") for m in available_models if "flash" in m.lower()]
            if flash_models:
                MODEL_ID = flash_models[0]
                logger.info(f"Dynamically selected model: {MODEL_ID}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Could not list models: {e}")

        self.auth = base64.b64encode(f"{FD_API_KEY}:x".encode()).decode()
        self.headers = {"Authorization": f"Basic {self.auth}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

    def format_date(self, date_str):
        if not date_str: return "None"
        try:
            dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
            return dt.strftime("%d %b %Y, %H:%M")
        except Exception:
            return str(date_str)

    def ai_call(self, prompt: str) -> dict:
        """Centralized AI handler with retry logic."""
        max_retries = 3
        for i in range(max_retries):
            try:
                response = self.client.models.generate_content(
                    model=MODEL_ID,
                    contents=prompt,
                    config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
                        response_mime_type="application/json",
                        temperature=0.2 # Lower temperature for more consistent analysis
                    )
                )
                if response.text:
                    return json.loads(response.text)
                return {}
            except Exception as e:
                error_msg = str(e)
                if "401" in error_msg or "expired" in error_msg.lower():
                    logger.error(f"FATAL: API Key Issue: {error_msg}")
                    sys.exit(1)

                wait = (2 ** i) + random.random()
                logger.warning(f"AI error (attempt {i+1}): {e}. Retrying...")
                time.sleep(wait)

        return {}

    def fetch_freshdesk_data(self, max_pages=8):
        """Fetches tickets with retry logic and pagination."""
        tickets = []
        logger.info(f"Syncing Freshdesk (Pages 1-{max_pages})...")

        with requests.Session() as session:
            for page in range(1, max_pages + 1):
                url = f"https://{DOMAIN}.freshdesk.com/api/v2/tickets"
                params = {"page": page, "per_page": 100, "include": "stats"}
                
                # Retry logic for Freshdesk API
                success = False
                for attempt in range(3):
                    try:
                        r = session.get(url, headers=self.headers, params=params, timeout=30)
                        if r.status_code == 200:
                            success = True
                            break
                        elif r.status_code == 429:
                            wait_time = int(r.headers.get("Retry-After", 10))
                            logger.warning(f"Rate limited. Waiting {wait_time}s...")
                            time.sleep(wait_time)
                        else:
                            logger.error(f"Error {r.status_code} fetching page {page}: {r.text}")
                            break
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.error(f"Fetch attempt {attempt+1} failed: {e}")
                        time.sleep(2)

                if not success: break
                
                batch = r.json()
                if not batch: break

                for t in batch:
                    if t.get("group_id") in GROUP_MAP and t["status"] not in [4, 5]:
                        brand_name, brand_color = GROUP_MAP[t["group_id"]]
                        t["brand"] = brand_name
                        t["brand_color"] = brand_color
                        tickets.append(t)

                logger.info(f" - Page {page}: Collected {len(tickets)} total active tickets")
                time.sleep(0.2) # Polite delay
        return tickets

    def score_ticket(self, ticket, is_repeat):
        """Refined risk score logic."""
        score, drivers = 0, set()
        text = f"{ticket.get('subject', '')} {ticket.get('type', '')}".lower()

        # Keyword Scoring (Weighted)
        for category, terms in KEYWORDS.items():
            if any(term in text for term in terms):
                weight = 8 if category == "escalation" else 5
                score += weight
                drivers.add(category)

        # Repeat Customer (High weight)
        if is_repeat:
            score += 7
            drivers.add("repeat")

        # Age/Stale Scoring
        try:
            updated = datetime.strptime(ticket["updated_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            hours_open = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - updated).total_seconds() / 3600
            if hours_open > 72:
                score += 10
                drivers.add("critical_stale")
            elif hours_open > 48:
                score += 5
                drivers.add("stale")
        except Exception: pass

        # Priority field from Freshdesk (1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent)
        priority = ticket.get("priority", 1)
        if priority >= 3:
            score += (priority * 2)
            drivers.add("fd_priority")

        # BRAND WEIGHTING: Strategic multiplier for key clients
        weight = BRAND_WEIGHTS.get(ticket.get("brand"), 1.0)
        final_score = round(score * weight, 1)

        return final_score, drivers

    def get_quickchart_url(self, chart_json):
        import urllib.parse
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(json.dumps(chart_json))
        image_url = f"https://quickchart.io/chart?c={encoded}"
        try:
            resp = requests.post("https://quickchart.io/chart/create", json={"chart": chart_json}, timeout=10)
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                image_url = resp.json().get("url")
        except: pass
        return image_url

    def generate_html_report(self, tickets):
        """Orchestrates report generation with parallel AI analysis."""
        subj_counts = Counter(t.get("subject", "").lower().strip() for t in tickets)
        enriched = []
        for t in tickets:
            is_repeat = subj_counts[t.get("subject", "").lower().strip()] > 1
            score, drivers = self.score_ticket(t, is_repeat)
            enriched.append({**t, "risk_score": score, "risk_drivers": drivers})

        by_brand = defaultdict(list)
        for t in enriched: by_brand[t["brand"]].append(t)

        total_tickets = len(enriched)
        critical_tickets = [t for t in enriched if t['risk_score'] >= 15]
        
        # Logic for "No First Response" (Grouped by creation day)
        no_first_response_tickets = [t for t in enriched if not t.get('stats', {}).get('first_responded_at')]
        nfr_by_day = defaultdict(list)
        for t in no_first_response_tickets:
            day = datetime.strptime(t["created_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            nfr_by_day[day].append(t)
            
        # Logic for "Delayed Response" (> 3 days without agent touch)
        delayed_response_tickets = []
        for t in enriched:
            last_agent_touch = t.get('stats', {}).get('agent_responded_at')
            if last_agent_touch:
                dt_touch = datetime.strptime(last_agent_touch, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                if (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - dt_touch).days >= 3:
                    delayed_response_tickets.append(t)
            else:
                dt_created = datetime.strptime(t["created_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                if (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - dt_created).days >= 3:
                    delayed_response_tickets.append(t)
                    
        # Helper for Modal data
        def t_json(t_list):
            return json.dumps([{"id": t['id'], "brand": t['brand'], "subject": t['subject'], "score": t.get('risk_score', 0)} for t in t_list])

        modal_data = {
            "critical": t_json(critical_tickets),
            "no_first": t_json(no_first_response_tickets),
            "delayed": t_json(delayed_response_tickets)
        }

        # 0. Generate Volume Charts
        brand_counts = Counter(t.get("brand", "Unknown") for t in enriched)
        type_counts = Counter(t.get("type", "Question") or "Question" for t in enriched)

        brand_chart_config = {
            "type": "bar",
            "data": {
                "labels": list(brand_counts.keys()),
                "datasets": [{
                    "label": "Tickets",
                    "data": list(brand_counts.values()),
                    "backgroundColor": [next((v[1] for k, v in GROUP_MAP.items() if v[0] == b), "#3b82f6") for b in brand_counts.keys()]
                }]
            },
            "options": {
                "title": {"display": True, "text": "Active Volume by Brand", "fontSize": 16},
                "legend": {"display": False},
                "plugins": {"datalabels": {"display": True, "color": "#000", "anchor": "end", "align": "top"}}
            }
        }

        type_chart_config = {
            "type": "bar",
            "data": {
                "labels": list(type_counts.keys()),
                "datasets": [{
                    "label": "Tickets",
                    "data": list(type_counts.values()),
                    "backgroundColor": "#6366f1"
                }]
            },
            "options": {
                "title": {"display": True, "text": "Volume by Ticket Type", "fontSize": 16},
                "legend": {"display": False},
                "plugins": {"datalabels": {"display": True, "color": "#000", "anchor": "end", "align": "top"}}
            }
        }

        brand_chart_url = self.get_quickchart_url(brand_chart_config)
        type_chart_url = self.get_quickchart_url(type_chart_config)

        # 1. Fetch Executive Summary
        overall_prompt = (
            "Analyze these open tickets and provide a sharp 5-line executive summary. "
            "Focus on trends, critical failures, and overall mood. Return JSON: {'summary': '...'}\n\n"
            + "\n".join([f"- {t['brand']}: {t['subject']}" for t in enriched[:40]])
        )
        overall_summary = self.ai_call(overall_prompt).get("summary", "Strategic summary currently generating...")

        # 2. Parallel Brand Analysis
        brand_insights = {}
        def analyze_brand(brand, brand_tks):
            brand_tks.sort(key=lambda x: x['risk_score'], reverse=True)
            context = "\n".join([f"ID {t['id']}: {t['subject']} (Score {t['risk_score']})" for t in brand_tks[:15]])
            prompt = f"""
            Analyze tickets for {brand}:
            {context}
            
            Return JSON:
            {{
                'pulse': '1-sentence health check',
                'keys': [{{'id': 123, 'label': 'subject', 'why': 'reason for risk'}}],
                'strategic_priority': 'one short phrase'
            }}
            """
            return brand, self.ai_call(prompt)

        logger.info("Starting parallel brand analysis...")
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as executor:
            futures = [executor.submit(analyze_brand, b, tks) for b, tks in by_brand.items()]
            for future in as_completed(futures):
                brand, res = future.result()
                brand_insights[brand] = res

        # 3. Plan of Action & Strategic Insights
        top_tickets = sorted(enriched, key=lambda x: x['risk_score'], reverse=True)[:15]
        poa_context = "\n".join([f"- {t['brand']} #{t['id']}: {t['subject']} (Score: {t['risk_score']})" for t in top_tickets])
        
        poa_prompt = f"""
        Act as a CS Director. Analyze these top-risk tickets and the brand breakdowns below.
        Provide:
        1. A 'Plan of Action' (4 bullet points).
        2. A 'Strategic Summary' (2 sentences on overall health).
        3. A 'Top Bottleneck' (1 sentence).
        
        JSON Format: {{
            'plan_of_action': [...],
            'strategic_summary': "...",
            'top_bottleneck': "..."
        }}
        
        TICKETS:
        {poa_context}
        """
        poa_data = self.ai_call(poa_prompt)
        poa_bullets = poa_data.get("plan_of_action", ["Prioritize high-risk tickets immediately."])
        strat_summary = poa_data.get("strategic_summary", "Volumes are stable but require focus on high-risk aging tickets.")
        bottleneck = poa_data.get("top_bottleneck", "Resource allocation on specialized brands.")

        # 4. Build HTML
        today_str = datetime.now().strftime("%d %B %Y")
        html = f"""
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
        <head>

                .hero {{ background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%); color: #fff; padding: 50px 40px; text-align: center; }}

                .kpi-box.critical {{ border-top: 4px solid #e11d48; }}
                .kpi-box.critical .val {{ color: #e11d48; }}

                                </div>
                            </div>
                        `).join('');

                    <strong>CONFIDENTIAL STRATEGIC REPORT</strong><br>
                    Generated by Ecomplete AI Intelligence Engine • Freshdesk Integration v3.1<br>
                    Insights based on {total_tickets} active customer signals.
                </div>
            </div>
        </body>
        </html>
        """
        return html

    def dispatch(self, html_content):
        msg = MIMEMultipart("alternative")
        msg["From"] = SENDER_EMAIL
        msg["To"] = RECIPIENT
        msg["Subject"] = f"CS Morning Brief – {datetime.now().strftime('%d %b %Y')}"
        msg.attach(MIMEText(html_content, "html"))

        try:
            with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.gmail.com", 587) as server:
                server.starttls()
                server.login(SENDER_EMAIL, SENDER_PASS)
                server.send_message(msg)
            logger.info("✅ SUCCESS: HTML Brief sent.")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"SMTP Error: {e}")

def run_report(send_email=True):
    """Execution entry point."""
    start_time = time.time()
    bot = MorningBriefAutomation()
    raw_tickets = bot.fetch_freshdesk_data(max_pages=8)
    
    if raw_tickets:
        report_html = bot.generate_html_report(raw_tickets)
        if send_email:
            bot.dispatch(report_html)
        
        logger.info(f"Execution finished in {round(time.time() - start_time, 2)} seconds.")
        return report_html
    else:
        logger.warning("No tickets found.")
        return None

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_report(send_email=True)
